profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience designing and developing web applications. Proven multitask abilities and team oriented. Able to work under pressure and open to learn new technologies. Characterized by rapid learning, self-improvement, and believe in good programming practices and techniques. Proficient in the full life cycle of the software development process.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Main activities and responsibilities:
- Developed and maintained modern LMS used by Fortune 500 companies including LG, Samsung, MasterCard, Celebrity Cruises, Liberty Mutual and more.
- Architected software modules and database schemas with the goal of producing an efficient, reliable, and highly scalable platform.
- Managed a team of two developers while responsible for code reviews and optimization in order to meet the highest code quality standards.
- Improved overall performance of the application by implementing asynchronous processing Rabbit MQ for large data set processing.
- Managed Amazon AWS and run weekly deployments using OpsWorks for higher level of control and efficiency.

Technologies:
Cloud Service Plattform: AWS
Backend: Symfony 2, Doctrine, RabbitMQ
Database: MySql
Fronted: HTML5, Javascript, CSS3, JQuery, Bootstrap
Project Management Tool: Jira
Version Control: Git

positions.title: Senior PHP Developer
positions.description:
Main activities and responsibilities:
- Architected software solution to implement RESTful services.
- Developed API for interacting with the Google Search Appliance to perform more efficient searches into the dynamic content.
- Developed enhancements and new features as well as hot fixes for the application in several environments.
- Created code-level documentation and refactored code.

Technologies:
Cloud Service Plattform: AWS
Backend: Wordpress
Database: MySql
Fronted: HTML5, Javascript, CSS3, JQuery
Project Management Tool: Jira
Version Control: Git

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Main activities and responsibilities:
- Designed and implemented new features across presentation layers.
- Decreased existing bugs and problems dramatically and delivery stable versions.
- Checked existing codes and performed a maintenance and refactoring plan.
- Created of custom templates of email marketing applications, used to promote the FIFA World Cup 2014.

Technologies:
Backend: ASP
Database: SQL Server
Fronted: HTML5, Javascript, CSS3, JQuery
Project Management Tool: Trello
Version Control: Perforce

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web application and interactive games for children

Main activities and responsibilities:
- Developed modules for Moodle Platform related to contents customization and tracking individual activities.
- Implemented APIs to consume several web services and protocols.
- Developed web application to automate the management of Medical Stories, which allowed the generation of advanced medical reports in an efficient manner.
- Designed the UX/UI of virtual travel agencies, working from initial evaluation to development of the prototypes.

Technologies:
Backend: PHP, Symfony
Database: MySQL
Fronted: HTML, Javascript, CSS, JQuery, ActionScript
Project Management Tool: Redmine
Version Control: SVN

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Main activities and responsibilities:
- Programmed Stored Procedures and other relational queries in SQL.
- Tested and deployed the application in the development environment and in production.
- Described and made white-box tests (Integration tests and System level tests and Acceptance tests).
- Captured and formally described requirements as well as use case realizations.
- Administered Network, offering a suitable level of maintainability of network and applications.

Technologies:
Backend: PHP, C#
Database: MySQL, SQL Server
Fronted: HTML, Javascript, CSS, ActionScript
Project Management Tool: Redmine
Version Control: SVN
